positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
LightForce is a digital platform providing orthodontists with fully customized, 3D printed tooth-movement tools. 

Founded in 2015 by Dr. Alfred Griffin, DMD, PhD, MMSc along with Dr. Lou Shuman, DMD, LightForce is revolutionizing the specialty through advanced manufacturing and technology. After four years of extensive research and development, LightForce launched their first product to the Orthodontic market- the world’s first, and only, fully customized 3D printed bracket system and digital treatment software. Learn more at www.lightforceortho.com.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer
positions.description:
	Electrical design for VA class submarine Weapons Launch Console (WLC)
	Developed automated wire harness tests for WLC used with DIT-MCO test system
->	Wrote VBA macros to parse and interpret system information from 400+ page wiring table spreadsheet, comprised of over 8,000 wired connections. 
->	Many wire harnesses incorporated unique rules, requiring intricate parsing algorithms.
->	Became an expert in electrical system testing methods such as insulation resistance and dielectric strength.
	Cognizant engineer for a major electrical design change to WLC
->	Created schematics in Visio to depict proposed design change.
->	Worked with the customer (Navy) and internal colleagues to approve the proposed change.
->	Worked with trades & manufacturing plant to implement change to design.
	Wrote technical Engineering Report documents for design and construction support purposes
	Provided troubleshooting for customer using circuit analysis, oscilloscopes, and other debugging tools
	Provided construction support to manufacturing plant

positions.title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
	Backend application development using Java, Spring, and SQL
	Developed reporting panels to display situation response time analysis
	Added capability to output alternate Audit Log message views

positions.title: Audio Engineer / Music Producer
positions.description: 	Built and operated professional recording studio

positions.title: Electrical Evaluation Engineer
positions.description:
	Tested & qualified Hard Disk Drives
	Worked directly with suppliers to root-cause disk failures
	Optimized the group’s Reliability Demonstration Test script
	Automated RDT data collection process

positions.title: Co-op
positions.description:
	Built boundary scan tests for new Service Processor boards
	Drove investigations of failing boards & tests
	Implemented new method of setting Digital I/O bits for boundary scan testing, increasing efficiency by 451%.

volunteerExperiences.description:
In 2018 I rode across Massachusetts in the Pan-Mass Challenge. It's a 192-mile bike ride to raise money and awareness for cancer research. It's a cause that I am very passionate about, and 100% of every rider-raised dollar goes directly to Dana-Farber. The PMC is the institute’s largest single contributor, raising more than 53% of the annual revenue at The Jimmy Fund. The PMC has contributed more than $598 million to Dana-Farber since its inception in 1980.

Prior to 2018, I have volunteered at the Franklin PMC water stop every August since 2003.

volunteerExperience.description:
In 2018 I rode across Massachusetts in the Pan-Mass Challenge. It's a 192-mile bike ride to raise money and awareness for cancer research. It's a cause that I am very passionate about, and 100% of every rider-raised dollar goes directly to Dana-Farber. The PMC is the institute’s largest single contributor, raising more than 53% of the annual revenue at The Jimmy Fund. The PMC has contributed more than $598 million to Dana-Farber since its inception in 1980.

Prior to 2018, I have volunteered at the Franklin PMC water stop every August since 2003.
